objective: Measure and improve the skill without changing criteria after observing results.
score_definition: Weighted capability coverage against a frozen public-practice reference set; not a market percentile and not scientific external validation.
before_after_rule: Apply identical weights, caps, scenarios, and environment to v13.3.0 and the improved candidate.
promotion_rule: No critical regression; all package tests pass from two clean extractions; added falsifiers pass; manifest is exact; before/after score does not decrease in any critical axis.
rollback: Preserve the original ZIP byte-for-byte and build the candidate under a new version and filename.
forbidden_mutations: install or publish without separate authorization
